lines: Every four years, the best soccer players play in the World Cup.
But do you know their uniform colors have special meanings?
Brazilian players wear their flag colors.
They wear a green and yellow jersey with blue shorts.
The green is for Brazil’s many forests.
The blue is for the sky.
Australian players wear a yellow jersey and shorts with green socks.
The yellow is for Australia’s national flower.
The green is for Australia’s nature.
The players of the Netherlands wear orange uniforms.
The orange is the color of the Dutch royal family.
body.text: Every four years, the best soccer players play in the World Cup. They play for their country. But do you know their uniform colors have special meanings? Brazilian players wear their flag colors. They wear a green and yellow jersey with blue shorts. The green is for Brazil’s many forests. The yellow is for gold. The blue is for the sky. Australian players wear a yellow jersey and shorts with green socks. The yellow is for Australia’s national flower. The green is for Australia’s nature. The players of the Netherlands wear orange uniforms. The orange is the color of the Dutch royal family. How about your country?
